resources.string: Connect this companion to show large, scannable card notifications on this phone.
Portemoné will manage nearby cards and post them through this companion. This companion does not access your location, store your cards, or run a background service.
After connecting, return to Portemoné. Full cards are selected automatically. Android updates may change how cards appear; you can disconnect at any time.
Install Portemoné before connecting this companion.
Portemoné and this companion are signed by different publishers. Install both from the same source before connecting.
Notifications are blocked. Open Notification settings to allow nearby cards.
Nearby cards are blocked. Open Notification settings and enable the Nearby cards category.
Could not update the companion. Try again.
Android did not confirm the connection. Try again.
Quiet card notifications managed by Portemoné when you are near a saved store.
